reviews.x: I am a huge makeup and beauty product fanatic so when I seen the JPNK set of four beauty sponges at such a great price point, I had to give them a try. The sponges (two black and two hot pink) came in an elegant little black box which had a flower design on the outside and the JPNK logo on the front. The box is made of plastic material but nice enough to save and store the sponges.  I own a few Original Beauty Blenders and was hoping these sponges would be my new "go to" since they are m

reviews.t: When I first got these I loved them and was going to give them 5 stars
reviews.x: When I first got these I loved them and was going to give them 5 stars, however I wanted to wait until I wash them first and I am glad I did.  Once you wash them they do get bigger but not so much where it would be an issue using them, but the bigger issue is the fact it sheds a lot, it seem to me they are only a one time use product, maybe twice at the most.

i like the sponges, they're pretty dense but they do blend concealer and foundation, it just takes a little longer than a beauty blender would. it's a much heavier type sponge when dry and wet,  they retain water more since its a thicker sponge than the beauty blenders do. if you're someone that doesn't want to feel the weight of a wet sponge then this isn't the one for you. im totally fine with the weight of it and how it blends, it takes a little longer but it still works, now this isn't a dup

Love them! Great price for a great product. I had bought a beauty blender from Sally's for $5, just for one. This is so much better! They are soft and work really well with all my makeup. Of course when they are wet the expand. Overall great product!!

I have never used a true Beauty Blender so I cannot compare this product to those, but I have used a few different brands of Beauty Blender dupes, and these are my least favorite. My first and biggest complaint is that these sponges do NOT last long. They rip very easily. All of the sponges I've owned have eventually developed tears, but not nearly as quickly as these, and not as severely as these. The rips are deep and the sponge pretty much splits in half, other sponges I could still get away

These are NOT like the original beauty blenders from Nordstrom.  I want to make that very clear.  I read reviews that people couldn't tell the difference but you definitely can.  On that note, I still like this beauty blender but the quality is a little less than the original.  You can feel a bit of the "plastic" if you know what I mean.

These are fantastic.  I've tried so many different beauty blenders, not wanting to pay $20 for just one, and these take the cake. I rinse it off or wash it nearly every day and while I just stick w/ one, it shows how durable and long lasting they are.  (bought these January 5th)  They are perfectly soft w/ just the right amount of firmness so your fingers don't sink into your face when you're blending or buffing out foundation.  I also use these for baking. I get no shedding, shredding or random

I wasn't sure what to expect but seeing as most of the reviews were good, I went for it. And I love it! It arrived on time. It's a good size, while some people said their's got bigger when it got wet, I didn't experience that 😢 But, it is a great buy. It's a steal of you ask me. Very good quality and very easy to work with. I will definitely buy again. And I highly recommend it.

reviews.t: THESE are amazing, cheap and four pack
reviews.x: THESE are amazing, cheap and four pack! I use them slightly damp and they actually last for 2 days wet, it is still damp the next morning! Using them wet also cleans them out every other day and they hold up very well! These worked wonders with my foundation, it applies so evenly and softly.
I love these!! They're so smooth and really help actually apply my make up properly. They don't crumble or peel either
hard and dense. crumble when you wash. grab the flower beauty ones or eco tools.
I love using these sponges. They are perfect!

Just received the sponges earlier today (12/19) and I wanna say that I am both impressed and disappointed LOL. I felt that the sponge did blend my foundation well and didnt soak up any of the product, but I was sad to see that it was already tearing due to when I was releasing water from it. I don't know if it was because I was squeezing too much or maybe my somewhat long nails tore into them but literally the first rinse and there's already really small tears. I'm honestly not the most gentle p

I've searched the internet for a great deal on sponges like these an I'm thankful I found these. I waited about 2 months before giving a review. I have not had a problem with the sponge yet and I have cleaned and used the same sponge for the past 2 months. I've tried Oval Brushes, Molly Cosmetic SillySponge and regular foundation brushes but I always loved these types sponges. These ones are great and the price is amazing too. I have sensitive skin with mild acne and these sponges are fantastic

I love beautyblenders, but I can't bring myself to spend $20 on a sponge especially when a new one should be purchased every month. I mean, it doesn't matter if you clean it after every use or not, using the same sponge long term isn't a good idea. So these definitely appealed to me. They are awesome. I wouldn't recommend them if you use a water based foundation, they soak up water & hold it more than the beautyblender. I prefer more full coverage foundations so these don't pose a problem for me

reviews.t: Honestly some of the best beauty sponges I've used
reviews.x: Honestly some of the best beauty sponges I've used. My go to is usually real technique but I've been using these for over three months and I love them!! I have purchased the all black pack and those were good, but I definitely prefer this pack. The two pink/reddish sponges are my favorite. I love the size and they don't soak up too much product. Definitely worth the money!!! I haven bought a real beauty blender in years and stopped buying real technique awhile back. My new favorite brand!!

This makeup blender is definitely high quality for the price comparing to the big name brand ones out there in the market right now. It is very soft and absorbs loads of water when used to clean daily. I've tried cheap ones in the past and they were made with way too rough of a material. I now use the JPNK makeup blender for my daily makeup liquid foundation and concealer daily use! The quantity offered in the package was more than enough bang for the buck! :)

I bought these to replace the beauty blenders that were starting to deteriorate. this product has the density of a sponge; very thin. Liquid gets absorbed and doesn’t apply as well as the traditional beauty blenders.  In comparison, when wet, this blender is a lot smaller than the original. Also these don’t have a flat bottom so they will roll around.  Dry, they are small and soft so they are good for under eye makeup.  You get four (2 black, 2pink).

Man I love these things! They make applying makeup flawless! They really do double in size when wet. I only recommend using them damp. They did start to break down after a couple wash es, so theese aren't built to last, but at $8 bucks a pack you can't beat it. The real beauty blender is $20. So I will take these all day every day!!!!

reviews.t: This is probably my favorite beauty blender I've owned so far
reviews.x: This is probably my favorite beauty blender I've owned so far. It's so much more absorbent and soft than those I've spent much more on in the past. This is definitely one of those great amazon finds. On days I don't have time for foundation primer, I no longer feel self-conscious with how well this applies the product.

reviews.t: Great bundle, soft and works amazing.
reviews.x: Just finally tried out one of these sponges today and I have to say I was really impressed. The box that comes with it is so cute and your sponges aren't tightly packed in there. It was so nice and soft and works amazing. I will definitely buy more.

If you're looking for something close to the actual $20 Beauty Blender, don't buy this. It's too dense and will absorb too much of your makeup. These don't clean easily. I bought these over a year ago, used once and threw away. Waste of money.

I used to buy Swissco sponges for around $7 a piece. They were discontinued, so I purchased these. They're even softer than my Swissco sponges and you get FOUR! That makes them $2 a piece and that's amazing. Love love love and will buy again.

reviews.t: You can’t beat the price and they are very good quality and last forever
reviews.x: I have bought these twice now. You can’t beat the price and they are very good quality and last forever. I have several daughters and between us we have tried so many beauty blenders. These are the ones I will continue to buy!

If I could give zero stars I would. This product was terrible super hard and did not blend my makeup at all. Left horrible lines and absorbed way to much product. Would never purchase again what a waste.

claims.text: Many reviewers consider these sponges a great value, praising the low price for a four-pack compared to more expensive alternatives.
Several reviewers say the sponges blend foundation and concealer well and apply makeup evenly.
A common complaint is that the sponges tear or rip easily and do not last long.
Some reviewers find the sponges hard, dense, or prone to crumbling and shedding, especially after washing.
Some reviewers note the sponges are not as high quality as original Beauty Blenders, though several still find them durable and long lasting.
